name: DCA Aunt Cass Café Warm Cinnamon-Caramel Sourdough Bread Pudding (Take Lactase)
brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Cubed Boudin sourdough bread soaked in warm vanilla-egg custard and baked soft—completely free of roughage when you choose a non-nut, non-citrus seasonal flavor (like Cinnamon, Caramel, or Pumpkin).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share a warm Bread Pudding cup, ask for extra crème anglaise/caramel on the side, and take 1–2 lactase enzyme tablets.
watchOuts: Verify the current seasonal bread pudding does not contain pecans/walnuts or lemon curd
